Mots neufs, aucun de cs-o050, cs-o096, cs-o102 ni du parent 85dd07fe ; définitions et exemples vérifiés dans leur sens courant : eloquence n'est pas repris (eloquent déjà fait) ; mots : astute, benevolent, concise, nuance, perseverance (place micabo, slide 6 : se tester). slides.texte_overlay: refined words that make you sound well read

astute
adjective — quick to notice and understand things
"an astute reader spots the theme in chapter one."

benevolent
adjective — kind and wanting to help
"our benevolent teacher stayed late to explain it again."

concise
adjective — short and clear
"keep your answer concise: three sentences."

nuance
noun — a small, subtle difference
"a good essay shows the nuance, not just yes or no."

perseverance
noun — continuing despite difficulty
"quizzing yourself every night takes perseverance."
